text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Turbo. It's nothing
impressive,
but we planned a little
birthday party for you.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
For real?! Woohoo, a birthday party!
And Turbo's
the birthday girl!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
By the way, it'll be Ikuno's and my
birthday in a
few days too.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Having multiple celebrations
clumped
together makes the occasion all
the more festive.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
So among us three, Turbo's birthday
comes first...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Uhh, it's totally gone to her head.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo's number one! Turbo's number
one!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Okay, now I'm kinda annoyed, so I say
we call off
Turbo's birthday party.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
With our birthdays coming up so soon,
we can
simply celebrate hers then as
well.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: No, no, no! You have to do it today!
